Boeing 777 Near-Miss Incident Sparks Aviation Safety Debate

A Boeing 777 aircraft reportedly performed a risky maneuver in the US, with its wing skimming inches from the runway. Widely shared footage of the incident has led to debate among aviation experts and pilots. Many have questioned the unusually low altitude at which the widebody aircraft was flown, considering the Boeing 777 is one of the world's largest twin-engine commercial aircraft and is typically operated with substantial safety margins.
